chunks.heading: Enterprise AI
chunks.text: A question lands in someone’s queue. “Is sampling witnessed for Q3 batches?” — the kind of question that costs an afternoon and gets asked again next quarter. READS 214 pages of the SOP, and finds the three sections that matter CHECKS 1,204 batch records against them, and flags four DRAFTS a reply, with every claim carrying the source it came from Then it stops. Nothing is sent, filed or actioned until a named reviewer approves it. That is the architecture, not a setting you can switch off. RECORDED who asked RECORDED what the system surfaced RECORDED who decided, and when The system drafts. Your team decides. Two years later, somebody will ask how that decision was made. chunks.heading: Pharma & Regulatory AI
chunks.text: An inspector writes one paragraph. Answering it will take your quality team three weeks, and the answer has to survive being read back to you. OBSERVATION — ILLUSTRATIVE Written procedures for sampling are not consistently followed, and the records do not show the step was witnessed by a second analyst. Fictional text. Not from any real inspection, company or product. ROOT CAUSE · BR-2291 The step was performed but not witnessed — the batch record has no field for it CORRECTION · SOP-QC-014 Analysts re-trained, the four Q3 batches re-reviewed PREVENTIVE · DEV-0471 A witness signature field added, and tracked in the deviation log Every paragraph carries the record it rests on. Not a model's recollection of a document. The document. Nothing is filed until QA signs. In a GMP environment a wrong answer is worse than no answer, so the system drafts and a qualified person decides. ILLUSTRATIVE. THE OBSERVATION IS FICTIONAL AND NAMES NO REAL INSPECTION, COMPANY OR PRODUCT. PHARMA & REGULATORY AI

chunks.heading: Sovereignty is decided in the cable plant.
chunks.text: A sovereign AI cluster means the compute, the data and the operator sit under Indian jurisdiction — so a regulated Indian business can train and run models without its data leaving the country’s legal reach. That is a procurement and engineering problem long before it is a legal one, and most of it lands on the links between the GPUs. A hall like this is mostly cable. The GPUs get the budget and the headlines. What decides whether they reach their benchmark is the metre of copper or glass between them. AT 400G AND ABOVE the margin between a link that works and one that retrains under load is small AND IT IS SET BY insertion loss, the reach of the optics actually fitted, the temperature at the top of the rack at 3am NONE OF WHICH appears in the bill of materials Sovereign is a supply chain, not a sticker. If every spare optic is a six-week import and every fault needs an engineer in another time zone, the operator is holding risk that was supposed to be designed out. We do the India side. Architecture, design-in, integration, qualification and support — on local time, close to the clusters being built. ILLUSTRATIVE VISUALISATION. NOT A PRAVERSE FACILITY — WE SUPPLY AND DESIGN IN THE INTERCONNECT, WE DO NOT OPERATE DATA CENTRES. THE TEST

chunks.heading: Four questions an operator should be able to answer.

chunks.heading: Why this company exists.
chunks.text: Praverse began in 2023, not as a company but as a question our founder kept running into across several years of research in medical imaging, edge inference and simulation: why does so much of this work stop at the paper? The models were not the problem. They worked, on real images, in real clinics — including clinics without reliable power or bandwidth. What was missing every time was the unglamorous half: the workflow the model had to live inside, the qualified person who had to sign it off, the audit trail somebody would ask for two years later. Research is rewarded for the first half. Patients only benefit from the second. By 2026 that had become specific enough to build a company around, and Praverse Tech Pvt Ltd was incorporated. Everything we ship assumes a qualified person is going to read it, disagree with some of it, and need to show their working — whether the output is a 483 response, a patient summary, or a link budget for a data-centre row.
